source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: The HAWK guide tells a pedestrian to push the button to request the WALK signal and wait for the signal to change.
corrections.note: Removed raised hand indication which the page does not state.

corrections.corrected_statement: At a rectangular rapid flashing beacon crossing drivers should come to a full and complete stop for pedestrians crossing the roadway.
corrections.note: Changed must to should to match the advisory wording on the page.

corrections.corrected_statement: To avoid becoming an aggressive driver obey the speed limit and be a courteous and patient driver.
corrections.note: Removed allowing time and space which the page does not state.

corrections.corrected_statement: Keep pets away from you as you drive, do not let them sit on your lap, and never leave a pet unattended in your vehicle.
corrections.note: Removed driving controls which the page does not state.

corrections.corrected_statement: When making a legal right turn on red you must make a complete stop before the crosswalk before reaching the intersection.
corrections.note: Removed added yielding requirement that the right on red rule does not state.

corrections.corrected_statement: When you park on the shoulder or side of any highway from sunset to sunrise or when light is insufficient to see people or objects one thousand feet away, you must turn on your hazard lights or parking lights if your vehicle is so equipped.
corrections.note: Added the missing qualifier that the light requirement applies only if the vehicle is so equipped.

corrections.corrected_statement: The handbook says drivers must use hand signals or directional signals to show that they are about to turn.
corrections.note: Removed arm position detail not stated in provided text.

corrections.corrected_statement: The handbook lists slow or stop as one of the hand signals.
corrections.note: Removed arm position detail not stated in provided text.

corrections.corrected_statement: The handbook lists left turn as one of the hand signals.
corrections.note: Removed arm position detail not stated in provided text.

corrections.corrected_statement: Double solid white lines separate same-direction lanes and may divide a special-use lane from ordinary lanes; crossing them is prohibited.
corrections.note: The same-direction definition is printed on page 57, not page 58.
